name: Lim Wei Jie
bio:
Lim Wei Jie has been immersed in the world of technology since his early days, fueled by a childhood fascination with computers and racing simulations. His passion for motorsport grew alongside his career, leading him to combine his expertise in IT with his love for racing. He believes a robust and innovative IT infrastructure is crucial for a team's success, enabling efficient data analysis, communication, and strategic decision-making.

Wei Jie is known for his meticulous approach to problem-solving and his dedication to optimizing systems for peak performance. He constantly seeks out new technologies and methodologies to enhance the team's capabilities. His ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable strategies makes him a valuable asset to Opala Legends. He is driven by the pursuit of excellence and committed to ensuring the team has a technological edge.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: A man of medium build with a focused gaze and a calm demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a multi-tool, even in the office.
Has a collection of vintage racing posters in his office.
Insists on using only mechanical keyboards.
